calibration: Too few synthetic control cases for calibrated probabilities; raw strength/confidence reported separately. Production validation calibration is in calibration.json.
interpretation: Native induction activates a deliberately withheld coarse conditional in the distance-specific control. The same generalization is already available through explicit host abstraction and native revision; no unique production benefit is established.
legacy_diagnosis: The same antecedents have direct revision evidence with higher confidence. Induction remains an alternative, never independent evidence to revise into its source. Its Truth_w2c(sBC*cBC*cBA) confidence is at most 0.5 for valid STVs. No classification benefit is forced.
production: Experimental only, disabled. The C4-full and no-induction production configurations are identical in semantics.

production_direct_hypothesis.derivation: Typed relative projection; never a native conjunction.

runtime.atomspace: PeTTa native in-process MeTTa space (no Hyperon AtomSpace dependency)

sampling: One observation per source group, preferentially the declared rook distance-one stratum, otherwise first ledger row. This is stratified selection, not a random chess population.
